subject.title: Google Chat: Add user OAuth support for reactions and media uploads

question: Which delegated Google Chat identity model should the bundled plugin support for user-only operations, and how should users provision and select that identity?
rationale: Per-user OAuth, administrator-approved domain-wide delegation, and remaining app-auth-only have materially different consent, storage, impersonation, attribution, and setup consequences that cannot be selected safely from implementation evidence alone.

options.title: Scoped user OAuth profiles
options.body: Add plugin-owned OAuth setup and SecretRef-backed credentials, preserve service-account defaults, and route only approved reaction, upload, and user-DM operations through the selected user profile.

options.title: Domain-wide delegation only
options.body: Support administrator-configured service-account impersonation for managed Workspace deployments, accepting a higher enterprise setup and privilege burden.

options.title: Keep app authentication only
options.body: Do not add delegated identity; retain explicit unsupported-operation diagnostics and improve graceful text-link or message-mode fallbacks instead.

recommendation.title: Scoped user OAuth profiles
recommendation.body: Add plugin-owned OAuth setup and SecretRef-backed credentials, preserve service-account defaults, and route only approved reaction, upload, and user-DM operations through the selected user profile.

likelyOwner.reason: They committed the original channel, have substantial subsequent area history, and already provided maintainer-side review context for this exact product decision.
